title: Act: Add cn helper, components.json and shadcn Button
summary: Install deps and create cn, components.json and Button
description: Install runtime deps and create the helper, shadcn config and Button component.
acceptance_criteria: Given src/lib/utils.ts, when imported, then cn is exported
Given button.tsx, when imported, then Button and buttonVariants are exported

steps.action: Add clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, @radix-ui/react-slot and @radix-ui/react-dialog to dependencies and run npm install
Create cn that merges clsx output through twMerge

Create shadcn config JSON with style 'default', rsc false, tsx true, tailwind.config 'tailwind.config.ts', tailwind.css 'src/styles.css', cssVariables true, aliases components '@/components' and utils '@/lib/utils'

Create shadcn Button: cva with base classes and variants default (bg-primary text-primary-foreground), ghost, outline; sizes default, sm, icon; forwardRef component using Slot when asChild and cn(buttonVariants(...), className)
steps.code: const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button'; return <Comp ref={ref} className={cn(buttonVariants({variant,size}), className)} {...props} />;
steps.expected: Button renders a button with bg-primary
